title: L0-005 Observation Schema
description: Data validation schema for L0-005 Bar-and-Coin Investment Holdings / Demand observations. Two record types share this schema: observation_period_type=annual and observation_period_type=quarterly. This implementation produces a demand-flow series only; accumulated holdings are not constructed.

observation_period.description: Period label exactly as it appears in the workbook header row. Annual: '2025'. Quarterly: "Q2'26".

observation_year.description: Calendar year. For quarterly records derived from period label (e.g. Q2'26 → 2026).

observation_quarter.description: Quarter number 1-4. Null for annual records.

bar_demand_tonnes.description: Gold Balance sheet Row 21: Bars. Metric tonnes. Annual records only; null for all quarterly records (WGC does not publish this sub-component at quarterly frequency).

official_coin_demand_tonnes.description: Gold Balance sheet Row 22: Official Coins. Metric tonnes. Annual records only; null for all quarterly records.

medals_imitation_coin_tonnes.description: Gold Balance sheet Row 23: Medals / Imitation Coins. Metric tonnes. Annual records only; null for all quarterly records.

total_bar_and_coin_tonnes.description: Gold Balance sheet Row 20: Total Bar and Coin. Reconciled global demand total. Metric tonnes. Available for both annual and quarterly records.

named_country_total_tonnes.description: Bar and Coin sheet Row 44: Total above (sum of named countries). Metric tonnes. May differ from Gold Balance total due to Other & stock change.

other_and_stock_change_tonnes.description: Bar and Coin sheet Row 45: Other & stock change. Metric tonnes. Can be positive or negative.

world_total_bar_and_coin_sheet_tonnes.description: Bar and Coin sheet Row 46: World total. Should reconcile with total_bar_and_coin_tonnes within 1%.

source_publication_date.description: Date WGC published this workbook. Recorded manually by operator at download time. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

download_date.description: Date operator downloaded the workbook. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp when parser processed this record. ISO 8601.

parser_version.description: Version of parse_bar_and_coin.py that produced this record.

underlying_providers.const: Metals Focus; Refinitiv GFMS; ICE Benchmark Administration; World Gold Council

is_revised.description: True when this record replaces a previously stored observation for the same observation_period with a changed value. A new period appearing for the first time is not a revision.

prior_total_bar_and_coin_tonnes.description: Previously stored total_bar_and_coin_tonnes for this observation_period. Required (non-null) when is_revised=true. Must differ from current total_bar_and_coin_tonnes.

revision_reason.description: Explanation of why the value changed. Required (non-null) when is_revised=true.

anomaly_notes.description: Required when validation_status is FLAG or FAIL. Describes the anomaly.
